info.name: Stakflo GRC — Tool Integrations
info.description:
All routes from `app.integrations.api.mount_integration_routes`.

**Variables:** `baseUrl`, `org_id`, `tool_id`, `user_id`, `oauth_code`, `oauth_state`, `snyk_api_token`, `snyk_org_id`, `aws_role_arn`, `aws_region`, `aws_sts_region`, `aws_external_id`, `aws_evidence_codes`, `prisma_api_base_url`, `prisma_access_key_id`, `prisma_secret_key`, `defender_tenant_id`, `defender_client_id`, `defender_client_secret`, `defender_subscription_id`, `orca_api_host`, `orca_api_token`, `lacework_account`, `lacework_key_id`, `lacework_secret`.

**Wiz:** service account — `graphql_url`, `client_id`, `client_secret`.

**Prisma Cloud:** CSPM REST — `api_base_url` (tenant API URL per pan.dev), `access_key_id`, `secret_key`; JWT via POST /login. Seed evidence EV-701.. with `source=prisma_cloud` before collect.

**Snyk:** API key / OAuth; `org_ids` or `group_id`.

**AWS (Cloud):** `POST .../integrations/cloud/aws/configure` with `configuration_data.role_arn` (IAM role ARN — **no region in ARN**; account ID only). Server credentials must allow `sts:AssumeRole`. Optional: `region` (default `us-east-1`), `region: "auto"` (multi-region via EC2 DescribeRegions), `sts_region` (AssumeRole endpoint, default `us-east-1`), `external_id` (cross-account trust). Evidence: `POST .../evidence/aws/collect` — `evidence_codes` null collects all seeded Cloud EV codes; or pass e.g. `["EV-16","EV-541"]`. Seed `evidence_masters` for the tool domain (app upsert or `scripts/sql/seed_aws_evidence_masters_cloud_domain.sql`).

**Okta:** `org_domain` + `api_token` (SSWS).

**Defender for Cloud:** Azure AD app (`tenant_id`, `client_id`, `client_secret`) + `subscription_id`; OAuth2 client credentials for `https://management.azure.com/.default`. Seed EV-711.. `source=defender_cloud`.

**Orca Security:** `api_token` + optional `api_host` (default `api.orcasecurity.io`); base URL `https://{host}/api`. Seed EV-721.. `source=orca_security`.

**Lacework:** `lacework_account` (subdomain) + `lacework_key_id` + `lacework_secret`; API v2 at `https://{account}.lacework.net/api/v2`. Seed EV-731.. `source=lacework`.

**Sync:** `provider_key` optional: `zoho_people` | `microsoft_entra` | `microsoft_entra_gcc_high` | `bitbucket_cloud` | `wiz` | `prisma_cloud` | `defender_cloud` | `orca_security` | `lacework` | `snyk` | `aws` | `jira_cloud` | `okta`.

Lacework API v2: POST /access/tokens with X-LW-UAKS; see lacework/go-sdk and docs.lacework.net.
Single-region workload default (`aws_region`, e.g. us-east-1). IAM role ARNs do not encode region — only account ID.
Uses EC2 DescribeRegions after AssumeRole to scan multiple commercial regions (requires ec2:DescribeRegions on assumed role).
Cross-account: optional external_id on trust policy; sts_region controls which regional STS endpoint performs AssumeRole.
Collects every AWS evidence master linked to this tool's domain (see evidence_map AWS_SEED_ROWS).
Set collection variable `aws_evidence_codes` to a JSON array string, e.g. ["EV-16","EV-541"].
Explicit list of all Cloud-domain AWS seed codes (same as ALL_AWS_EVIDENCE_CODES in code).
